description: This file declares function prototypes, macros, and includes related to RBus operations for the TDK library, serving as an interface for RBus communication in the project.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_checkStatus
methods.description: Checks the current status of the RBus connection.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_open
methods.description: Initializes and opens an RBus connection.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_dataElements
methods.description: Performs operations on data elements identified by given parameters.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_session
methods.description: Starts a new RBus session with specified operation.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_closeSession
methods.description: Closes an existing RBus session identified by sessionID.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_discoverComponentDataElements
methods.description: Discovers data elements of a specified component.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_getValue
methods.description: Gets the value and type of a parameter.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_registerOperation
methods.description: Registers an operation with the RBus component.

methods.name: ssp_rbus_set_log_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level for RBus.
